texts.release.0.1.0.feature.course.detail: 16 sections, 60 lessons and 272 tasks, including assessments and console projects.
texts.release.0.1.0.feature.course.title: A hands-on C++ course
texts.release.0.1.0.feature.editor.detail: C++ editing, highlighting, line numbers, drafts and self-completion of code-writing tasks.
texts.release.0.1.0.feature.editor.title: A native editor
texts.release.0.1.0.feature.storage.detail: Atomic writes, backup, export and import. Only unambiguous answers are checked automatically, not source code.
texts.release.0.1.0.feature.storage.title: Local progress
texts.release.0.1.0.summary: The version that existed before rebranding, recorded in Info.plist. No separate release date or stage was recorded; history is not reconstructed through invented releases.
texts.release.0.1.0.title: The original working CodePath build
texts.release.0.1.1.feature.history.detail: A separate updates window is available from the menu and Settings. The read marker is saved locally.
texts.release.0.1.1.feature.history.title: History close at hand
texts.release.0.1.1.feature.identity.detail: A new name and an original open-laptop icon. The previous Bundle Identifier and data folder are retained.
texts.release.0.1.1.feature.identity.title: Meet codelib
texts.release.0.1.1.feature.version.detail: Settings and About codelib show the version, Alpha stage and build number from app metadata.
texts.release.0.1.1.feature.version.title: Version without guesswork
texts.release.0.1.1.improvement.44ff551213020d: Release history is stored in a structured offline resource.
texts.release.0.1.1.improvement.bf8c784a7e401d: A signature green accent and a consistent style for new utility windows.
texts.release.0.1.1.summary: The first stage of the update: a recognizable name, an original icon and a transparent release history. Your existing lessons and results stay with you.
texts.release.0.1.1.title: A new codelib identity
texts.release.0.1.10.feature.achievement-strin: Categories use LocalizedStringResource in the UI layer. Hidden labels, recognition and acquisition dates, and banners use explicit localizable templates. All 24 achievement titles still appear in Russian, like the rest of the app.
texts.release.0.1.10.feature.course-english.de: Structures and classes, constructors and invariants, const/constexpr and C++ guarantees, map/set, files and errors. The English draft now contains 2437 of 2904 text fields without changing C++, answers or fixtures.
texts.release.0.1.10.feature.progress.detail: A file-based round trip covers 31 choice tasks from sections 6–14 and preserves drafts, profile, awards, positions and unknown IDs. Translation does not create separate progress.
texts.release.0.1.10.feature.progress.title: Keeping canonical answers
texts.release.0.1.10.improvement.80329f38fb865: Secret achievements still hide their titles and requirements until earned.
texts.release.0.1.10.improvement.ab6e99002d10c: LearningCore remains independent of SwiftUI; category resources are declared in the UI.
texts.release.0.1.10.summary: Continuing CHANGELOG1 §10: the developer translation covers 14 sections, 54 lessons and 248 tasks. Category labels and achievement messages are prepared for native Apple localization. English remains unavailable until translation is complete.
texts.release.0.1.10.title: Objects, guarantees and reliable data
texts.release.0.1.11.feature.course-english.de: The last 10 lessons and 48 tasks cover console protocols, file preservation, the final dispatcher, prefixes, windows, two pointers and binary search on the answer. Code, canonical answers and fixtures are unchanged.
texts.release.0.1.11.feature.course-english.ti: Projects, review and the algorithm lab
texts.release.0.1.11.feature.review-gate.detai: Tests confirm 2904/2904 coverage and draft status: the production loader rejects an unreviewed translation even when complete. File-based checks cover all 97 automatically checked course answers.
texts.release.0.1.11.feature.review-gate.title: Coverage does not replace review
texts.release.0.1.11.feature.ui-resources.deta: Page names, task types, completion statuses and avatars are prepared for native Apple localization in the UI layer. Persisted enum values and progress are unchanged.
texts.release.0.1.11.feature.ui-resources.titl: Menus, statuses and avatars as resources
texts.release.0.1.11.improvement.9e56f7c50a690: Draft status does not change automatically at full coverage; English is not offered yet.
texts.release.0.1.11.improvement.f12f03702fd03: Translated labels are not used as progress keys.
texts.release.0.1.11.summary: All 2904 text fields of the English draft are prepared: 17 sections, 64 lessons and 296 tasks. This is a technically complete draft, not an English app ready for use: review, errors, resources and language selection still need work.
texts.release.0.1.11.title: A translation draft of the entire course
texts.release.0.1.12.feature.error-ui.detail: Export, import, reset, recovery and photo handling use structured messages. The underlying reason uses the same explicit locale; unknown system diagnostics remain data rather than being translated through text matching.
texts.release.0.1.12.feature.error-ui.title: A template and its underlying error
texts.release.0.1.12.feature.storage.detail: Tests cover failure types, revision conflicts, locks, protected exports and file preservation on failed import or reset. A message is not a substitute for a successful write.
texts.release.0.1.12.feature.storage.title: Progress protections remain intact
texts.release.0.1.12.feature.typed-errors.deta: Course, translation, profile, catalog, history and storage errors have typed reasons and parameters. Core Russian fallbacks are preserved; LearningCore remains independent of SwiftUI.
texts.release.0.1.12.feature.typed-errors.titl: A reason instead of a string
texts.release.0.1.12.improvement.435e623f316f1: Course coverage checks still do not turn a draft into a reviewed translation.
texts.release.0.1.12.improvement.4cd4d9dcf058b: Photo and decoding errors use explicit UI templates instead of preformatted strings in state.
texts.release.0.1.12.summary: Continuing CHANGELOG1 §10: core error reasons are separate from text, and the UI retains the original error, formatting it with native Apple resources when displayed. Full English is not enabled yet.
texts.release.0.1.12.title: Errors with a clear cause
texts.release.0.1.13.feature.resource-translat: Titles, descriptions, feature cards, improvements and fixes are translated. Versions, dates, stages, course and feature IDs, icons and course availability remain canonical.
texts.release.0.1.13.feature.stable-keys.detai: The catalog uses course IDs; history uses versions and feature IDs. Improvement and fix strings are addressed by a fingerprint of the source value, not an array index.
texts.release.0.1.13.feature.stable-keys.title: Keys do not depend on position
texts.release.0.1.13.feature.validation.detail: Source SHA256, coverage, empty or unknown fields and resource type are checked. Loaders reject drafts; previews do not change update order, routing or the read marker.
texts.release.0.1.13.feature.validation.title: A complete draft is not a ready language
texts.release.0.1.13.improvement.46560555bb2de: Changes to release notes require a deliberate translation review, not automatic fingerprint replacement.
texts.release.0.1.13.improvement.85a807d11515e: Authored translations and generation are reproducible; drafts stay outside Resources.
texts.release.0.1.13.summary: Continuing CHANGELOG1 §10: text-only English drafts now cover the catalog and the entire release history. The app remains in Russian; the translations are not reviewed and are not bundled.
texts.release.0.1.13.title: Catalog and history without losing identity
texts.release.0.1.14.feature.diagnostics.detai: The original error is retained. Technical text with its domain and code is available separately and copied only at the user's request; it may remain in the system language and is never sent anywhere.
texts.release.0.1.14.feature.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics on demand
texts.release.0.1.14.feature.presentation-loca: The main window, Settings, history and About use one Russian locale. Profile, study and award dates, percentages and dynamic text resources are formatted explicitly; the time zone remains local.
The app locale, not the system locale
texts.release.0.1.14.feature.system-errors.det: Permission failures, missing files, insufficient space, read-only volumes and existing files have separate messages based on Cocoa and POSIX domain/code pairs. Unknown errors use a neutral message without text matching.
texts.release.0.1.14.feature.system-errors.tit: A reason based on the error code
texts.release.0.1.14.improvement.1bb7e3d0ff1c3: Theme preview labels and the quit warning are prepared as native Apple localizable resources.
texts.release.0.1.14.improvement.b61531a224c9b: Formatting does not change persisted dates, study-day keys, progress or preferences.
texts.release.0.1.14.summary: Continuing CHANGELOG1 §10: the interface uses an explicit Russian locale, and system errors get understandable messages instead of text in an arbitrary macOS language. English is not enabled yet.
texts.release.0.1.14.title: One language for dates and errors
texts.release.0.1.2.feature.profile.detail: A Unicode name, initial, preset avatar or local photo with cropping. Edit the profile in Settings.
texts.release.0.1.2.feature.profile.title: Your local profile
texts.release.0.1.2.feature.updates.detail: Release history appears after setup, not over it. A new installation starts with learning.
texts.release.0.1.2.feature.updates.title: Updates at the right moment
texts.release.0.1.2.feature.welcome.detail: A programming-language greeting with skip and Reduce Motion support. Name and theme setup resumes after closing.
texts.release.0.1.2.feature.welcome.title: A first introduction
texts.release.0.1.2.improvement.67d324522cde35: Your name and avatar appear in the sidebar, with a personalized greeting.
texts.release.0.1.2.improvement.c99af6b6d320e4: Setup completes only after a successful disk write. Errors can be corrected and the action retried.
texts.release.0.1.2.summary: A local profile and initial setup without registration. Existing tasks and drafts are preserved. The interface and course are currently in Russian.
texts.release.0.1.2.title: Meet your lab
texts.release.0.1.3.feature.repository.detail: Checks for published files and conservative cleanup of old diagnostic runs retain the latest reports.
texts.release.0.1.3.feature.repository.title: A tidy project
texts.release.0.1.3.feature.translation.detail: Translation changes labels, not C++ sources, expected output, test data or persisted answer-choice values.
texts.release.0.1.3.feature.translation.title: Text separate from checking
texts.release.0.1.3.feature.validation.detail: An incomplete, stale or unreviewed translation cannot load as a production course. An English draft of the first lesson is available only to developers.
texts.release.0.1.3.feature.validation.title: No mixed languages
texts.release.0.1.3.improvement.06c98944bb7e9a: Reproducible translation generation verifies the source course version.
texts.release.0.1.3.improvement.704f943800321b: Persisted progress and answers are checked across changes to displayed labels.
texts.release.0.1.3.summary: A course-localization layer is prepared without changing learning IDs or persisted answers. The interface and available course remain in Russian: full English is not ready yet.
texts.release.0.1.3.title: A foundation for safe translation
texts.release.0.1.4.feature.algorithms.detail: Prefixes and differences, sliding windows, two pointers and binary search. Includes 20 code-writing tasks and a trip-capacity mini-project.
texts.release.0.1.4.feature.algorithms.title: From range sums to answer search
texts.release.0.1.4.feature.resume.detail: Opening a lesson returns to its saved task or first unfinished task, rather than always its first task.
texts.release.0.1.4.feature.resume.title: Continue instead of starting over
texts.release.0.1.4.feature.syllabus.detail: Search sections, topics, task names and skills; filter lessons by not started, in progress or completed.
texts.release.0.1.4.feature.syllabus.title: Find the practice you need
texts.release.0.1.4.fix.7fd567f239c3550259a980: Duplicate translation-choice-label checks are removed; the rules are centralized in course validation.
texts.release.0.1.4.improvement.58e57601f4466a: New reference solutions receive additional checks against independent brute-force algorithms on small inputs.
texts.release.0.1.4.improvement.b917bd45f150fc: The developer verifier can check one section without overwriting the overall report.
texts.release.0.1.4.summary: A complete new C++ lab: 1 section, 4 lessons and 24 tasks. There are now 17 sections, 64 lessons and 296 tasks. Your existing progress stays with you.
texts.release.0.1.4.title: Algorithms in action
texts.release.0.1.5.feature.awards.detail: Categories, visible progress, dates, a secret achievement and detail cards. Self-review marks are clearly separate from automatic answers and do not count as running C++.
texts.release.0.1.5.feature.awards.title: Your collection
texts.release.0.1.5.feature.comfort.detail: Preview and separate font-size resets. Resetting a draft to starter code requires confirmation and preserves learning history.
texts.release.0.1.5.feature.comfort.title: Comfort without losing work
texts.release.0.1.5.feature.notifications.deta: Sequential glass banners, an original short sound and an on/off preference. Notifications appear only after an award is persisted.
texts.release.0.1.5.fix.762b724c7dc053c9958364: Repeated checks and relaunches do not grant an award again. Existing and unknown award IDs are retained.
texts.release.0.1.5.improvement.9caf9f7f29a9c3: An avatar and recent awards on the home screen, an achievement count in statistics, and adaptive metric cards.
texts.release.0.1.5.improvement.ec9a6e54a29d3b: A stable profile UUID and creation date for new profiles; an unknown historical date is not invented.
texts.release.0.1.5.summary: 24 achievements for real actions, an original sound and an award collection. Existing progress is recognized quietly, without a notification flood. This stage adds no lessons: the course contains 17 sections, 64 lessons and 296 tasks.
texts.release.0.1.5.title: Practice with personality
texts.release.0.1.6.feature.accessibility.deta: Reduce Motion shows a statement immediately; Reduce Transparency replaces glass with an opaque panel. After skipping or with reduced motion, all five statements remain manually accessible.
texts.release.0.1.6.feature.translation.detail: All 380 text fields from the first two sections are prepared outside the app. Generation rejects holes within declared sections, duplicate IDs and changes to protected data.
texts.release.0.1.6.feature.translation.title: Translating whole sections
texts.release.0.1.6.feature.welcome.detail: Highlighted statements in five languages, a soft fade, skip, and a finite animation with no endless loop. These are output examples, not code execution.
texts.release.0.1.6.feature.welcome.title: Hello, World! Without unnecessary motion
texts.release.0.1.6.fix.09f6796f8f390bbfd033e2: Accessibility paths are tested without trying to modify read-only macOS settings.
texts.release.0.1.6.improvement.5b5314d208f3d8: Animation logic is separate from SwiftUI and tested without timers; highlighting does not rewrite code fragments.
texts.release.0.1.6.improvement.78842a5ff8f0f3: Canonical IDs, answers, C++ sources and course progress are unchanged.
texts.release.0.1.6.summary: The CHANGELOG1 greeting is refined and the developer translation now covers the first two sections, 8 lessons and 40 tasks. Full English is not ready and is not enabled in the app.
texts.release.0.1.6.title: A greeting and the first translations
texts.release.0.1.7.feature.contracts.detail: IDs, C++, persisted answers and fixtures do not change. Checks cover UI placeholders, declared-section completeness and extraction freshness against current sources.
texts.release.0.1.7.feature.contracts.title: Preserving contracts
texts.release.0.1.7.feature.course-english.det: Three more complete sections cover grouping, division and bounds, logic, rule priority, loops and streaming telemetry. The draft covers 967 of 2904 text fields.
texts.release.0.1.7.feature.ui-catalog.detail: Xcode compiler extraction and a genuine Apple String Catalog: 76 translations of 186 extracted keys. The catalog is developer-only and is not copied into the app.
texts.release.0.1.7.feature.ui-catalog.title: A native foundation for interface translation
texts.release.0.1.7.improvement.0adfb07b81758f: The UI catalog passes the real xcstringstool compiler; developer absolute paths are not stored in the repository.
texts.release.0.1.7.improvement.ef68d556cc5637: Incomplete English is not presented as a ready language or mixed into the Russian UI.
texts.release.0.1.7.summary: Continuing CHANGELOG1 §10: the developer translation covers five sections, 20 lessons and 100 tasks. The working interface and course remain in Russian until full English is ready.
texts.release.0.1.7.title: Translation without losing meaning
texts.release.0.1.8.feature.course-english.det: Functions and contracts, ASCII and UTF-8, significant spaces, searching, and array and vector bounds. The draft contains 1554 of 2904 text fields, 32 lessons and 160 tasks.
texts.release.0.1.8.feature.progress.detail: A file-based test for the new sections preserves canonical answers, drafts, lesson positions, profile and awards when changing course presentation. This tests the core, not a finished UI language switch.
texts.release.0.1.8.feature.progress.title: Checking translation preserves data
texts.release.0.1.8.feature.ui-catalog.detail: The developer catalog covers 186/186 compiler-extracted keys for lessons, syllabus, statistics, achievements and history. Dynamic messages and resource data still need localization; the catalog is not bundled.
texts.release.0.1.8.feature.ui-catalog.title: Extracted keys translated
texts.release.0.1.8.improvement.e5c82fb539d885: Incomplete English stays outside the app until every screen and the course are ready.
texts.release.0.1.8.improvement.ffbb625cd6257f: Protected C++, IDs, expected results and fixtures are unchanged.
texts.release.0.1.8.summary: Continuing full translation under CHANGELOG1 §10. Developer English covers eight sections and all 186 previously extracted UI keys. This is not yet a complete English course or interface; the app remains in Russian.
texts.release.0.1.8.title: Functions, text and collections
texts.release.0.1.9.feature.compatibility.deta: The file round trip now covers 21 choice tasks from sections 6–11. Profile, drafts, positions, awards and unknown IDs are checked; changing the course presentation does not modify the progress file.
texts.release.0.1.9.feature.course-english.det: Another 11 lessons and 44 tasks are translated: begin/end ranges, search and sorting, lifetime, ownership and invalidation. The draft contains 1994 of 2904 text fields without changing C++, answers or progress.
texts.release.0.1.9.feature.native-strings.det: PageHeader and Metric labels use LocalizedStringResource instead of plain String. Xcode extracted 23 additional keys, including the greeting with a name. The developer-only catalog covers 209/209 keys, not all app messages.
texts.release.0.1.9.improvement.2e4f60dede4605: The user's name remains a literal greeting parameter, and the first-lesson fallback is extracted separately.
texts.release.0.1.9.improvement.fe105c168d8d6c: Header case is applied after localization, not by transforming the source key.
texts.release.0.1.9.summary: Continuing CHANGELOG1 §10: the developer translation covers 11 sections, 43 lessons and 204 tasks. Headers and metrics use native Apple localizable resources. Full English is not ready or enabled yet.
texts.release.0.1.9.title: Ranges, memory and interface language
